title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Syiling. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Syiling
options.thesis: The screen is a pocket of coins: every value is struck, and state is told by relief, not colour.
options.viewport: Pale nickel ground, fifteen flush category plates in three columns, the amount struck in at the foot above a flat keypad; the selected plate is raised by one brass hairline and a two-line underline.
options.risk: Relief built out of shadows turns into bevel chrome on a cheap Android panel.

raised.raise: Unprinted ground: a large field of the screen is left empty on purpose, and nothing is allowed to fill it.
One magnitude ramp sets every size here — amount, category, label — so hierarchy is a single number, not four type sizes.
Motion is steps(2) at 90ms: relief flips in two frames, and nothing on this screen eases.
Whole-cell reflow: a category plate never reflows inside itself, it moves or it stays.

options.label: Papan Harga
options.thesis: Your categories are a painted price board, read top to bottom, with every figure flush right.
options.viewport: Deep green board, numbered uppercase category plates ruled in cream hairlines, the amount painted large at the foot over a double rule, vermilion marking the live category.
options.risk: Also where most runs in this category land, and the nostalgia reads slow if the board is taken literally.

options.label: Metro tiles
options.thesis: Flat colour fields and giant lowercase: the type is the interface and the chrome is deleted.
options.viewport: Black ground, lowercase section words, fifteen flat tiles of which the live one floods cyan, the amount set at 58px over a chrome-less keypad.
options.case: Holds product clarity easily; tiles are already how this screen wants to read.
options.risk: Its tiles are a layout, so only the type, palette and density can travel — the rest stays here.

options.label: Emission line
options.thesis: A working plate: state is line form — solid, dashed, doubled — never a change of hue.
options.viewport: Charcoal continuum crossed by a sodium hairline; fifteen ash plates each carry a 1px edge that doubles when selected; the amount sits under a ruled plot band.
options.case: Strongest density and state discipline in the hand; a spectrograph has no home in this audience’s world.
options.risk: Reads as an instrument, so the money has to fight for the first look.

options.label: Factory catalogue
options.thesis: Every record is a catalogue entry: a fac number as the headline, a colour strip for a name.
options.viewport: Vast unprinted black, one white line plot owning the field, entries navigated by number.
options.case: Fuses poorly: coded state costs a legend on a screen someone uses in a queue.
options.kept: Unprinted ground — the hand’s biggest donation, now a raise on the assigned direction.

options.label: Star atlas
options.thesis: Importance is dot diameter on a fixed magnitude ramp, and the type declines the hierarchy.
options.viewport: Deep navy plate, ranked dots, a red-flashlight ring around the object under the eye.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a money screen read as a chart hides the task behind the notation.
options.kept: One magnitude ramp for all scale — now a raise on the assigned direction.

options.label: Acetate manual
options.thesis: Punched acetate plies hinged a millimetre above one full-strength coloured board.
options.viewport: One saturated board, a clear leaf over it, the book’s extent drawn as a stepped tab rail.
options.case: Fuses poorly: its rank and tab rail are navigation, which this mode will not hand to a world.
options.kept: steps(2) at 90ms, no easing anywhere — now a raise on the assigned direction.
options.risk: A material study that forgets the keypad.

options.label: Character roster
options.thesis: A cast of rounded mascots ranked across a pastel grid, each with a name plate and a birthday.
options.viewport: Pastel ground, mascot cells ranked, the active one taking its ribbon colour.
options.case: Fails on product truth: PRODUCT.md commits to no mascot in the MVP.
options.kept: Whole-cell reflow — now a raise on the assigned direction.
options.risk: Childish where the brief says friendly, never childish.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The arrangement every money app ships, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: White ground, segmented control, tinted category pills, a large right-aligned amount and a standard keypad.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
